# Capacities import fixtures (S5, FR-IMP-23, D-50)

Hand-written, **synthetic** mini exports, one per BRD §15.1 finding. Nothing comes from the real exports. Each folder is an extracted export with space folders (`<Space>/<Type folder>/<note>.md`); the tests select space `PKM`. The zip variants (FR-IMP-07) are built from these folders at test time.

Generated byte-exact; media files are 1×1 placeholders. Tests: `spikes/s5-capacities-import/tests/fixtures_report.rs`.

| Finding | Fixture | What it reproduces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C1 several spaces, overlapping type names | `c01-spaces/` | `IDC`, `PKM`, `Work`, each with `Tasks/` and `Pages/`; links from PKM to a Work object by title and by path |
| C2 typed YAML frontmatter | `c02-typed-frontmatter/` | user type `Book` with number, checkbox, select attributes; `ENG`/`eng` select variants; links inside code; one note with broken YAML (skipped and reported) |
| C3 UTC-midnight dates | `c03-utc-midnight-dates/` | `date: '…T00:00:00.000Z'`, a non-midnight date-time, `null` |
| C4 date ranges | `c04-date-ranges/` | `2026-07-01 -> 2026-07-14` and a range of UTC-midnight date-times |
| C5 media objects | `c05-media-objects/` | `Images/*.md` + `Images/Media/*` (URL-encoded diacritics), generic `image (3).png`, unreferenced `Untitled (44).png`, PDF object with a missing preview image, a page embedding the image |
| C6 weblinks | `c06-weblinks/` | folded `>-` URL, `domain`, `iframeUrl`, `previewImage: null` |
| C7 query shells | `c07-query-shells/` | two queries with title and description only |
| C8 tag collections | `c08-tag-collections/` | header-only CSVs, one with a BOM |
| C9 unresolved links | `c09-unresolved-links/` | `[[Date/…]]`, `[[NOTE/<uuid>]]`, a missing title, a missing path link, `status: '[[in progress]]'` |
| C10 duplicate titles | `c10-duplicate-titles/` | two meetings `Tomáš : Eva` (files `… (1).md`), a path link with unencoded parentheses, an ambiguous `[[Tomáš : Eva]]`, three weblinks titled `Article` |
| C11 file names differ from titles | `c11-file-names/` | `11 2026-03-19 Jana.md` titled `1:1 …`, trailing space, `#` and `[ ]`, a Czech title over 200 bytes, relation attribute |
| C12 task dates | `c12-task-dates/` | `date` + `deadline` + `completed`; statuses `Not Started`, `In Progress`, `Done`, `null` |
| C13 daily notes | `c13-daily-notes/` | timestamp lines (`09:15`, `7:05`), `reviewed: true/false` |
| C14 reserved keys | `c14-reserved-keys/` | `source: kniha`, `file: notes.txt` |
| C15 common attributes | `c15-common-attributes/` | `description`, `aliases`, `icon`, `coverImage`, `createdAt`, `lastUpdated` |
| C16 comma-separated people | `c16-comma-people/` | `people: Jana, Tomáš, Eva` |
| C17 invisible characters | `c17-invisible-chars/` | BOM, U+200B in title and body, ZWJ inside an emoji (kept) |
| C18 checklists | `c18-checklists/` | `- [ ]`, `- [x]`, nested, `*` marker |
| C19 AI chat | `c19-ai-chat/` | `type: 'AIChat'` → Page |
